svg.title: Three Families, by Job
svg.desc: Judge the task first, then pick a family: Haiku for high-volume simple tasks, Sonnet for most everyday writing and analysis, and Opus for the hardest multi-step reasoning as the most capable of the three; the model menu also lists other models such as Fable, which sits above Opus.
svg.text: Judge the task first; versions change, families don't.
Many steps, conflicting information or judgement: heavier. Simple, repeatable, high volume: lighter.
Other models, such as Fable, above Opus for the most demanding work
